title: California Public Contract Code section 10222 - Amount of bonds under the State Contract Act
claims: Section 10222(a) provides that each bond shall equal at least one-half of the contract price, except as otherwise provided in Section 9554 of the Civil Code, in the California Toll Bridge Authority Act, or in subdivision (b).

Section 10222(b) provides that, notwithstanding subdivision (a), for projects with a contract price greater than two hundred fifty million dollars ($250,000,000), the Department of Transportation shall have the discretion to specify that the payment bond shall equal not less than one-half of the contract price or five hundred million dollars ($500,000,000), whichever is less.
notes: Fetched 2026-09-30 from the publisher's own site and read in full. The one-half figure is expressly subject to Civil Code section 9554, which sets a public works payment bond at not less than 100 percent of the total amount payable; this record does not resolve how the two interact on any particular state contract.
